dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing of the lateral margins from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle area.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Median tone consistent with slate grey; non-white surface with low-intensity highlights.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, high-contrast, dark circular aperture or mark located on the anterior dorsal midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent dark circular anomaly is present on the anterior dorsal surface, showing high contrast against the grey baseline.
